summary: The one-coordinate threshold proof recorded in REPORT.md for exact zero-loss product-indicator purification assumes a finite-measure quantile threshold, which need not exist on the noncompact line. The exact theorem is therefore not used as proved here. Retain the safe optimizer-free epsilon-loss finite-mixture reduction: strict cap-one product slab witnesses transfer with arbitrarily small loss to bounded finite-union unit-measure product indicators. The new Pluecker/high-score/hub-strip coefficient theorems are unaffected.
challenged_claim: Exact zero-loss witnesswise product-indicator replacement via the displayed threshold-set proof on R.
safe_replacement: For every strict slab witness and every epsilon>0, bounded finite-union unit-measure product indicators reproduce the slab probability up to epsilon loss, via L1 approximation, finite hypersimplex mixtures, tensoring, and component selection.
effect_on_new_structural_results: NONE: QFORM-HIGHSCORE-INTERSECTING-58-v1 and QFORM-LOWSCORE-TO-HUBSTRIP-18-v1 are coefficient-only consequences of account02/B13 r39.
